label: Bible Study
prompt: It was meet that we should make _____, and be glad: for this thy brother was dead, and is alive again; and was lost, and is found.
verse: It was meet that we should make merry, and be glad: for this thy brother was dead, and is alive again; and was lost, and is found.
note: The father's answer to the resentful older brother — the prodigal's party was a must.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Which doeth great things and unsearchable; marvellous things without _____:
verse: Which doeth great things and unsearchable; marvellous things without number:
note: Eliphaz describes God's works as marvellous things without number — nobody can count that high.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And they said one to another, Behold, this _____ cometh.
verse: And they said one to another, Behold, this dreamer cometh.
note: Joseph's brothers spotted him coming across the field and sneered, 'Behold, this dreamer cometh' — the dreams came true anyway.

label: Deep Water
prompt: LORD, make me to know mine end, and the measure of my days, what it is; that I may know how _____ I am.
verse: LORD, make me to know mine end, and the measure of my days, what it is; that I may know how frail I am.
note: David asks God to show him how short life is — and in the next verse calls it a handbreadth.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Again, When a righteous man doth turn from his righteousness, and commit iniquity, and I lay a _____ before him, he shall die: because thou hast not given him warning, he shall die in his sin, and his righteousness which he hath done shall not be remembered; but his blood will I require at thine hand.
verse: Again, When a righteous man doth turn from his righteousness, and commit iniquity, and I lay a stumblingblock before him, he shall die: because thou hast not given him warning, he shall die in his sin, and his righteousness which he hath done shall not be remembered; but his blood will I require at thine hand.
note: Ezekiel the watchman learns the stakes: if he fails to warn the backslider, God will require that blood at his hand.
